يعتصمون (form VIII)
# يَعْتَصِمُونَ (yaʕtaṣimūna) /jaʕ.ta.sˤi.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# يُعْتَصَمُونَ (yuʕtaṣamūna) /juʕ.ta.sˤa.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
